title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

trophies.name: Breath of the Wild
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy in the base game.

trophies.name: Out of the Wild
trophies.description: Complete the Great Plateau and leave for the rest of Hyrule.

trophies.name: Trial and Error
trophies.description: Complete your first Shrine.

trophies.name: Shrine and Shine
trophies.description: Complete all 120 Shrines in the base game.

trophies.name: Tower Power
trophies.description: Activate every Sheikah Tower in Hyrule.

trophies.name: Ya Ha Ha!
trophies.description: Find your first Korok Seed.

trophies.name: A Forest Full of Koroks
trophies.description: Find all 900 Korok Seeds in Hyrule.

trophies.name: The Whole Kingdom
trophies.description: Reach 100% completion on the Hyrule map.

trophies.name: Zora's Domain
trophies.description: Free Divine Beast Vah Ruta.

trophies.name: Goron of the Mountain
trophies.description: Free Divine Beast Vah Rudania.

trophies.name: Flight of the Rito
trophies.description: Free Divine Beast Vah Medoh.

trophies.name: Gerudo Champion
trophies.description: Free Divine Beast Vah Naboris.

trophies.name: Beastly Business
trophies.description: Free all four Divine Beasts.

trophies.name: Sword of the Hero
trophies.description: Obtain the Master Sword.

trophies.name: Memories of a Lost Age
trophies.description: Recover all of Link's lost memories.

trophies.name: Castle in the Sky
trophies.description: Reach Hyrule Castle.

trophies.name: Calamity's End
trophies.description: Defeat Calamity Ganon.

trophies.name: The Beast Within
trophies.description: Defeat Dark Beast Ganon and complete the main story.

trophies.name: The Hero's Journey
trophies.description: Complete every Main Quest in the base game.

trophies.name: Helping Hand
trophies.description: Complete your first Side Quest.

trophies.name: Hyrule's Helping Hand
trophies.description: Complete every Side Quest in the game.

trophies.name: Quest for Knowledge
trophies.description: Complete every Shrine Quest.

trophies.name: Home Sweet Home
trophies.description: Purchase and fully furnish Link's house in Hateno Village.

trophies.name: Fairy Fine
trophies.description: Discover all four Great Fairy Fountains.

trophies.name: Horse Around
trophies.description: Register a horse at a Stable.

trophies.name: Horse of a Different Color
trophies.description: Equip a registered horse with a bridle and saddle.

trophies.name: Monster Hunter
trophies.description: Earn all three medals from Kilton by defeating every Hinox, Talus, and Molduga.

trophies.name: Dressed for Adventure
trophies.description: Obtain every piece of armor available in the base game.

trophies.name: Fashionably Upgraded
trophies.description: Upgrade a piece of armor at a Great Fairy Fountain.

trophies.name: Fairy Tailor
trophies.description: Fully upgrade a complete armor set.

trophies.name: Ancient Arsenal
trophies.description: Obtain the Ancient Helm, Ancient Cuirass, and Ancient Greaves.

trophies.name: A Champion's Blessing
trophies.description: Obtain all four Champion abilities.

trophies.name: Hestu's Gift
trophies.description: Expand your inventory for the first time by trading Korok Seeds with Hestu.

trophies.name: Shield of Legend
trophies.description: Obtain the Hylian Shield.

trophies.name: Picturing Hyrule
trophies.description: Complete the Hyrule Compendium.

trophies.name: Trial by Fire
trophies.description: Enter the Trial of the Sword.

trophies.name: Trial of the Sword
trophies.description: Complete all 45 rooms of the Trial of the Sword and awaken the true power of the Master Sword.

trophies.name: Master of the Wild
trophies.description: Complete the main story in Master Mode.

trophies.name: A Masked Forest
trophies.description: Obtain the Korok Mask.

trophies.name: Hero of Many Eras
trophies.description: Collect all eight pieces of armor introduced in The Master Trials.

trophies.name: Fast Travel, Literally
trophies.description: Obtain the Travel Medallion.

trophies.name: Been There, Done That
trophies.description: Unlock Hero's Path Mode.

trophies.name: The One-Hit Wonder
trophies.description: Begin The Champions' Ballad and wield the One-Hit Obliterator.

trophies.name: Divine Trials
trophies.description: Complete all of the new Shrines introduced by The Champions' Ballad.

trophies.name: A Champion's Trial
trophies.description: Complete the four Champion's Ballad trials.

trophies.name: A Fifth Divine Beast
trophies.description: Complete the Divine Beast Tamer's Trials and enter the final dungeon of The Champions' Ballad.

trophies.name: The Final Monk
trophies.description: Defeat Monk Maz Koshia.

trophies.name: Master of the Cycle
trophies.description: Obtain Master Cycle Zero.

trophies.name: The Champions Remembered
trophies.description: Recover all new memories revealed through The Champions' Ballad.

trophies.name: A Hero's New Wardrobe
trophies.description: Collect all nine pieces of armor introduced in The Champions' Ballad.

trophies.name: Horse of the Ancients
trophies.description: Obtain both pieces of Ancient Horse Gear.

trophies.name: The Champions' Ballad
trophies.description: Complete The Champions' Ballad and uncover the final memories of Zelda and the Champions.
